claims_excluded: hard real-time bound beyond frozen finite windows

decision.diagnostic_pass: instrumentation is proven loaded by an input-free subprocess and the live run records exact producer retirement method entry/return timestamps or a bounded trace showing which call remains open at callback release.
decision.stop: One fixture, one dispatch, at most one cancel; never replay or retry. Any setup mismatch stops before input.
decision.strict_action_outcome: The R29 strict blocked-release gate is unchanged: 21 or more same-call polls during a full 1250 ms post-cancel hold must show recovered/release-confirmed and the separate same-generation Q-up readback must be valid before callback return; otherwise preserve FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN.

environment.host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
environment.low_level_hooks_timeout_registry: HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\LowLevelHooksTimeout absent at R29 preflight; read only

host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
hypothesis: After independently proving the fixture is actually in Q-down state, a single held injected Q-up callback and public cancellation will show whether recovery clears that exact key while the hook callback is blocked.

instrumentation.mode: Test-only wrappers time helper exchange, _recover, release_all and Win32Backend._send including exact VK_Q key-up fields. R33 changes only the owned hook stimulus: pass one injected Q-down and independently verify Q-down state, then hold the first injected Q-up callback. One delayed independent readback runs after recovery SendInput return and before callback release.

nonclaims: hard real-time bound beyond frozen finite windows
resource_boundary: One user-authorized local Windows PC, one owned fixture/window and hook; one dispatch, one cancellation, one 1250 ms Q-up callback hold after an independent true Q-down baseline. No text operation, retry, replay, external window, or registry mutation. WSLc S01 remains a separate sibling packet.
retry_policy: Input-free hash/predecessor/registry preflight then one fresh fixture, one public dispatch, and at most one cancel after the exact held Q-up callback and same-call running status; no input retry or replay. The pre-cancel independent readback must prove Q-down true for the same generation; otherwise stop before cancel. Preserve any failure.

admission.target_generation: exact generation returned by this attempt public interface_observe

trial.cancel: one public interface_cancel for the exact dispatch call_id; no second cancel
trial.effect_order: Fixture click and CTRL+S save happen before the Q-down/Q-up cancellation point; effect oracle is independent after the full recovery flow.

native_stimulus.event: first injected VK_Q WM_KEYUP after the injected Q-down callback returned and independent same-generation readback proved Q-down
native_stimulus.hook: one WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook in the probe process
native_stimulus.release: Hold only the first Q-up callback for 1250 ms after the cancel response; release at frozen hold end or callback 1500ms self-deadline. Before cancel, require a separate process to observe Q-down true for the exact fixture generation.

trial.pre_cancel_readback: After hook entry, interface_results must show action status running before one interface_cancel call.
trial.target: One fresh owned fixture process/window and one exact generation; require independent Q-down true before the single cancel.
